sources.title: Q3 2026 letter to shareholders with 2026 guidance and 2027 outlook (6-K exhibit 99.2, 12.11.2026)

against.note: The params and the thesis of 11.11 were committed to Git on 2026-11-11 07:04 UTC (commit 1343e80), before the report, but the valuation was frozen in the ledger only on 2026-11-15: by the rule in research/RULE_CHANGES_he.md this is descriptive only.

items.metric: revenue Q3 2026 against the model year 2026 minus H1 (reported before the valuation)
items.note: Model FY2026 revenue 3,300M (frozen forecast row) minus H1 981.3M (Q2 6-K, in the valuation) = 2,318.7M for H2. Q3 delivered 980.8M = 42.3% of it with half of the time; Q4 now needs 1,337.9M, 36% above Q3. Q3 includes about 325M of non-recurring partnership revenue (letter): without it Q3 is about 656M (28.3%). No ahead/behind word on a partial year.
release table; the model has no nine-month figure
letter: 'approximately $325 million of non-recurring revenue as part of our asset-light model'
release statement of operations: 50.4M (5.1% of revenue); nine months -253.5M. The model has no 2026 margin (the base year); its 2027 margin is 3.09%.
letter: 'we now expect 2026 revenue at the low end of our $3.0-3.4 billion range'; guidance, not a reported number
letter: initial 2027 outlook 'revenue of $12-13 billion'; the model's 2027 base is 11,500M (frozen forecast row)
letter: 'approximately $27 billion, above our $20-25 billion range'; model 22,000M (frozen params notes, net_cash)

items.metric: ARR at the end of September 2026
items.note: letter: $6.4B, up 113% from $3.0B at the end of June; the company no longer guides on ARR

falsifiers.text: Cancellation or delay of part of the Microsoft contract
falsifiers.note: letter: in New Jersey more than half of the capacity contracted with Microsoft by year-end, the remaining tranches now scheduled for 2Q27; the contracts remain in place (a delay, not a cancellation)

notes: Scored by hand from the company's 6-K filings on SEC EDGAR, read on 2026-11-16. NBIS is a foreign filer: its quarters are not in SEC XBRL.
The two later valuations (12.11 and 13.11) were made after this report and are not scored against it.
